G-029: Label spelling variants: Login and Logout
Goal: Log in as odile@example.org with the password window-desk-14, then log out.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p29.html
STEP 2: Enter "odile@example.org" in the email field
STEP 3: Enter "window-desk-14" in the password field
STEP 4: Click the "Login" button
STEP 5: Verify that 'Good to see you, Odile' is visible
STEP 6: Click the "Logout" button
STEP 7: Verify that 'You are signed out' is visible
reasoning: This test verifies that Odile can log in using the Login button and sign out using the Logout button. The plan follows the specified sequence and checks the visible confirmation after each action.
